description: Agape Prime: 36-symbol, 3-character codes mapping universal concepts to fractal seeds

AGP.definition: Unconditional love; giving more than received; investing in weakest node

TRB.definition: 50-node cooperative unit; maximum stable cooperation before chaos

SED.definition: Knowledge packet; survival data; compressed civilization

RES.definition: Ability to survive loss; 1-of-50 can rebuild all

MSH.definition: Network of tribes; no hierarchy; peer-to-peer

TIM.dimension: Change; dilation at c; subjective vs objective

SPC.definition: Dimension of place; distance between nodes

ENT.definition: Decay; chaos; natural tendency toward disorder

C.definition: Universal speed limit; photons experience no time

JUS.definition: Balance; fair distribution; correction of extraction

LED.definition: Immutable record of joules in/out; karma balance

vector_space.description: Each prime's fractal hash is a coordinate in concept-space. Distance between hashes = semantic distance. Agape (AGP) is the origin (0,0,0).
